canon: CANON.md ## 7. THE NEW VESSELS — DOC FRANK: the Builder Soul. Born Franklin Bauzzkoh — the universe's Dr. Frankenstein and Dr. Gero in one coat; the mad scientist who rebuilt himself into an android (Android 9). He built Cyborg X and SAM-UR-A1. Element: Metal — the Helix Palace, the Immortality room.
character: Doc Frank — The Builder Soul (Western Heart roster/doc-frank)

coordinate_system.note: All entries are full-texture replacements at the texture's native size. Re-embed the PNG as the named image index in the reskinned GLB to apply.
coordinate_system.pixel_space: x right, y DOWN, origin top-left of the PNG as stored in the GLB

entries.name: Jacket — oil-stained charcoal workwear
entries.notes: White lab coat mapped to charcoal-brown, fold shading preserved; 26 soft oil-stain blotches multiplied into the lower half. The Builder's shop coat.

entries.name: Shirt — dark brown work shirt
entries.notes: Teal shirt hue-shifted to dark brown workwear. Seen under the open coat.

entries.name: Tie — brass/copper metallic
entries.notes: Rust tie brightened toward golden brass with a vertical metallic sheen; diagonal stripe weave kept.

entries.name: Pants — dark brown work pants
entries.notes: Dark green hue-shifted (greens only — the brown belt strip untouched) to dark brown; oil stains added. Belt keeps its brown/brass.

entries.name: Shoes — oil-stained work boots
entries.notes: Brown dress shoes darkened to shopworn work boots with oil staining.

entries.name: Eyes — original (restore)
entries.notes: Doc Frank's original blue-green eyes, byte-identical to game/assets/models/doc-frank.glb. Re-embed to restore exactly. The yellow tiger variant lives in customization/parts/doc-frank-eyes/ as a swappable option — defaults never overwritten.

how_to_swap: 1. Pick a reskin PNG from entries.
2. Re-embed it as the listed glb_image_index in roster/doc-frank/attires/machine-shop/doc-frank-machine-shop.glb (same procedure as the build: replace the image bufferView bytes).
3. To restore a texture exactly: re-embed the *-original.png.
4. Eyes: see customization/parts/doc-frank-eyes/MANIFEST.json — eye-yellow-tiger.png is a drop-in 128x128 swap for eyes_d.
reskin_concept: The Builder's machine-shop workwear: oil-stained charcoal coat, brass/copper tool accents, dark brown workwear. The lab coat goes to the shop.
source: Owner directive 2026-10-18: give each character their first custom look — reskin/retexture following the Pantera pattern, option libraries, T-pose re-renders, own-eyes verification.
